description: Finds text (OCR) with bounding boxes and, optionally, objects with bounding boxes in images. Accepts images and/or zip files of images. Output: annotated/<name>.jpg (boxes drawn) and result.json with every box, text and confidence per image.

images.description: Storage keys of images and/or zips of images (an array).

detect.description: Detect objects with bounding boxes (default false; downloads a detector model on first use).
